title: Delete Persistent Storage Object
description: Delete a persistent list by passing the unique ID. You can delete the persistent list only if it is not used in a playbook. A successful request returns a 200 status code, else the response includes a `non_field_error` object.

body.name: is_removed
body.description: Pass true to delete the persistent list.

path.name: persistent_storage_unique_id
path.description: Pass the unique ID of the persistent list to retrieve the details. You can retrieve the unique ID of a persistent list using the **Get Persistent Lists** endpoint.

body.name: result
body.description: Returns an object explaining why the deletion of the persistent list was unsuccessful.

items.name: non_field_error
items.description: Returns the reason the persistent list was not deleted.
items.value: This persistent list has associated playbooks

body.name: status_code
body.description: Returns a status code for the failure of the deletion. For example, *400*.
